title: Restricted gate width
statement: For a DNF term $T$, a coordinate restriction $\rho$, and a gate type, define the restricted gate width to be the restricted width of $T$ under $\rho$ when the gate is AND, and the restricted width under the negated assignment restriction when the gate is OR.
caveat: The formal statement uses the upstream notions of restricted width and negated assignment restriction, whose definitions are not included in the supplied definitions.
